[RDSC.14.3.3] `node_id` is the bundle-global node index carried by
every `AlphaNode`, `BetaNode` and `TerminalNode` atom. `ds_line` and `ds_col` are the 1-based DS
source line and column of that node's originating construct.
`module_id` identifies the owning module (display path via
`DsSource[module_id]`). Fields 2 and 3 are reserved and never reissued.
